main_measure.name: OLS slope of 48-bar return minus drift on the Monday 00:00 forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 500 cases and supporting mean > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 500 cases

supporting_check.name: mean of forecast sign x (48-bar return - drift)

decided_by: Confirm: the slope is positive with t >= 2 over at least 500 cases and the supporting mean is above 0.
reading: Cases are all coin-week bars closing at Monday 00:00 UTC with a recorded forecast and a 48-row forward return inside the window, pooled across coins in one OLS with its ordinary slope t; drift is each coin's mean 48-bar return on the 0,48,96,... grid of all its windows; the supporting mean counts every case, a zero forecast giving 0.
